verdict.rationale: Temporal's core model is 'Workflows-as-Code' where developers write Workflows and Activities directly in JavaScript/Python (and other SDKs), with docs and Python/TypeScript walkthroughs demonstrating real code as workflow steps, plus SDK APIs for Activity execution. Community evidence corroborates that workflows are ordinary code (with a determinism constraint) rather than a no-code/DSL system. missing for 10: a concrete first-party code sample showing an inline JS/Python function as a workflow step in the pack, and independent hands-on confirmation of writing custom logic beyond the determinism caveat.
